subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Identify, select and use appropriate apparatus for accurate measurement and volumetric work.
notes: Apparatus coverage is present in the pilot lesson; verify every required apparatus and syllabus statement against the official 2025-2027 PDF.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Carry out and interpret quantitative volumetric analysis, including titre collection and concentration calculations.
notes: Pilot includes rough and accurate titres, concordance, mole calculations and an original worked example; not yet a complete official assessment map.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Record experimental observations and measurements clearly, accurately and with appropriate units and precision.
notes: Both pilots include structured recording; verify official conventions and full scope.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Use systematic tests and observations to distinguish ions and gases, and support conclusions with confirmatory evidence.
notes: The pilot is an introductory framework, not a substitute for the complete syllabus test table or laboratory practice.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Recognise hazards and use safe procedures when handling reagents, heating substances and carrying out tests.
notes: Safety notes exist in the pilots; complete a reagent-by-reagent risk and disposal review before learner release.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Follow a suitable sequence of operations, minimise contamination and recognise how procedural choices affect results.
notes: No standalone lesson yet; build original guided practice and check exact syllabus expectations.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Process practical data using appropriate chemical relationships, units, significant figures and transparent working.
notes: Titration calculations are covered in the pilot; broader practical data-processing scope remains unbuilt.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Interpret the quality of experimental evidence and recognise limitations or sources of error where required.
notes: Some uncertainty and error discussion exists; expand only after confirming the exact Chemistry 9701 practical criteria.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Translate an experimental question into a workable plan, identifying variables and how they will be measured or controlled.
notes: Create a chemistry-specific planning lesson after checking the exact Paper 5 syllabus section.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Choose suitable apparatus and describe a clear, repeatable experimental procedure.
notes: Do not reuse Physics examples as if they were Chemistry syllabus content.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Identify relevant hazards and propose appropriate precautions for a planned chemical investigation.
notes: Verify the scope and expected depth in the official Chemistry 9701 syllabus.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Specify suitable measurements, ranges, intervals, repeats and recording arrangements for an investigation.
notes: Build chemistry-specific planning practice with realistic datasets and original scenarios.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Select and apply suitable methods to process practical results and interpret chemical relationships.
notes: Confirm exact syllabus wording, calculations and expected graphical methods before authoring.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Draw conclusions supported by processed data and explain the strength or limitations of the evidence.
notes: Create explicit evidence-to-conclusion exercises after official mapping.

subject: Chemistry
curriculum_skill_summary_original_paraph: Evaluate a proposed or completed method and justify practical improvements.
notes: Build a dedicated planning/evaluation module after official mapping and subject review.
